unregistered: unregistered — accepted under RFC 9126 section 2.4 for an authenticated client
withdrawTitle: Withdraw this request_uri: the authorization endpoint refuses it from now on
noneHeld: No pushed authorization request is held in this realm.
noneMatch: No pushed authorization request matches this filter.
heldNote: Held: {total} matching, at most {capacity} live per realm (oauth2.parMaxRequests), each for {lifetime} seconds (oauth2.parRequestUriLifetimeS). A spent request_uri is kept until it would have expired, so a replay is refused as already used rather than as unknown. Withdrawing needs Admin Write.
parNote: A client pushes the parameters of an authorization request to /oauth2/par over the back channel and is answered a request_uri; the browser then carries only that reference to /oauth2/authorize. The request is read there at least twice in one browser flow and is spent when an authorization response is issued on it.
parNoClients: No client has pushed an authorization request in this realm since the process started.
stepUpNote: A resource server that finds the authentication behind a token too weak or too old answers 401 insufficient_user_authentication with the acr_values and max_age it needs, and the client repeats them in an authorization request. The authorization endpoint answers from the session when the session meets them, sends the person to sign in again once when it does not, and refuses unmet_authentication_requirements when that sign-in did not meet them either. Each authorization-endpoint count is one pass, so a step-up that succeeds counts once as sent to sign in again and once as met after signing in. The context classes this service produces are
ownRequires: This service's own resource server (UserInfo, the OpenID4VCI endpoints, SCIM, Shared Signals) requires
ownApi: . A registered API's requirement is on its application entry (oauthStepUpAcrValues, oauthStepUpMaxAge), enforced by {path}.
stepUpNoClients: No authorization request in this realm has carried acr_values or max_age, and no resource server here has challenged a token, since the process started.
lead: What the authorization server has done in this realm since {since}, one section per mechanism. The counters are merged across every process answering this realm.
